title: Oil extends gains as US-Iran hostilities escalate, Brent hits $97.20
summary: Brent crude rose for a third straight day to $97.20/barrel (+0.20%) as US and Iran traded military strikes — US struck 3 Iranian oil tankers Saturday, Iran fired ballistic missiles at US warships. Goldman Sachs raised Brent Dec 2026 forecasts by $5 to $85/barrel. WTI at $92.56 (+1.07%).
why: 当日新闻：Brent创近年新高，美伊军事冲突直接影响霍尔木兹海峡石油出口预期，为当日最重大宏观事件。

title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000 as Fed rate hike odds hold near 60%
summary: Bitcoin fell below $79,000 on Tuesday, down more than 1% on the day. CME FedWatch shows ~60% probability of a Fed 25bps hike next week. Zcash led crypto losses. The token has spent a fortnight failing to close above $80,000.
why: 当日新闻：Fed 9月加息预期推动比特币跌破$79,000，为当日加密市场标志性价格关口事件。

title: Trump turns up the heat on Warsh as Fed September rate hike looms
summary: With FOMC meeting next week (Sept 17), Trump pressured Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to avoid raising rates, warning it would hurt the economy. Markets still price ~60% odds of 25bps hike amid US inflation near 3.5% and oil above $90.
why: 延续报道：美联储9月17日决议是本月最大市场事件，Fed政策预期每日均有新进展，当前距会议仅9天，仍在持续发酵窗口内。

title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for almost $13 billion in AI expansion
summary: Nvidia announced acquisition of Hugging Face for approximately $12.9 billion, adding the world's leading open-source AI model hub to its AI infrastructure stack. CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC that Hugging Face approached Nvidia weeks ahead of the deal.
why: 延续报道：Nvidia收购Hugging Face为本年度最大AI行业并购，SEC文件尚未存档，监管审批进展仍在持续发酵。

title: OpenAI announces rollout of GPT-6 Astra model; Jensen Huang declares 'AGI has arrived'
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra on September 3, trained on 100,000+ Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs at the Stargate facility in Texas. Jensen Huang declared 'AGI has arrived' on Sept 6. Sam Altman told CNBC Astra is 'a new capability level.'
why: 延续报道：GPT-6 Astra发布是本年度最重大AI事件，Jensen Huang于9月6日再发声，各方解读仍在持续发酵，直接影响英伟达估值逻辑。

title: Tesla's stock drops 6% as Cybercab update 'underwhelms,' NHTSA probe opens
summary: Tesla's Cybercab publicly launched in Austin on September 3 but drew immediate regulatory scrutiny: NHTSA opened an audit into ~1,000 Cybercabs examining Tesla's self-certification of federal safety standards compliance. Wells Fargo analysts called the launch 'underwhelming.' App topped App Store charts but users reported routing errors.
why: 延续报道：NHTSA调查尚未结束，Cybercab运营与监管进展仍在演变中，距发布日仅4天。

title: Labubu meets LVMH: Pop Mart to open flagship store in Paris amid cooling overseas sales
summary: Pop Mart founder Wang Ning travelled to Paris ahead of the brand's first European flagship store opening on Boulevard Haussmann. He met LVMH Chairman Bernard Arnault and presented him a Labubu doll. LVMH's Moynat brand partnered with Labubu previously; LVMH Asia Pacific president Wu Yue joined Pop Mart as outside director Dec 2025.
why: 当日新闻：泡泡玛特创始人拜会LVMH董事长为里程碑品牌事件，欧洲旗舰店开业是出海战略重要节点。

title: 【公告汇总】9月7日上市公司股份回购一览：腾讯控股耗资1亿港元回购22.8万股
summary: 腾讯控股(00700)9月7日斥资约1亿港元在港交所回购22.8万股，回购价格区间为438.4-442.4港元/股。回购计划持续进行，累计回购规模逾4324万股（截至9月1日）。同日阅文集团(00772)亦回购40万股。
why: 当日新闻：腾讯9月7日单日回购1亿港元为近期回购计划持续执行的重要数据点，对估值具参考意义。
